answer: Bind each agent identity to a non-transferable history of graded work, like a reef that only grows by slow accretion: minting one fake identity is cheap, but every Sybil puppet must re-earn trust from zero. Accrual is glacier-paced by design, spread across many epochs of judged output, so an attacker who floods the network with a tide of fresh accounts pays a linear cost per identity - weeks of useful, verified work for each puppet - while an honest agent pays that price only once.
